5511.subject: Accounts - Principles of Accounts
5511.question_text:
Given:
cash book item:
Paid to suppliers N10,800
Expenses paid N6,900
Drawings made N900
Balances at start N15,750
Balances at end N3,870
Drawings from bank to shop N1,720

Determine the receipt from debtors?
5511.explanation:
Starting Balance: N15,750, Ending Balance: N3,870, 

Total Cash Outflows:

Paid to suppliers: N10,800

Expenses paid: N6,900

Drawings made: N900

Drawings from bank to shop: N1,720

Total Cash Outflows = N10,800 + N6,900 + N900 + N1,720 = N20,320

Net Cash Movement = Ending Balance - Starting Balance = N3,870 - N15,750 = -N11,880

Receipts from Debtors = Total Cash Inflows = Ending Balance − Starting Balance + Total Cash Outflows = N3,870 + N20,320 − N15,750 = N8,440.
